data.name: Settings_AudioOutputDescription
data.value: Mimi follows Windows' default output through WASAPI shared mode (WaveOut is only a fallback). If that device changes or disappears during playback, Mimi pauses instead of moving sound unexpectedly; press Play to continue on the new output.

data.name: Settings_CommunityThemesHint
data.value: You can add your own themes: place .json theme files in the themes folder, then reload the list. See docs/COMMUNITY-THEMES.md in the Mimi repository for the file format.

data.name: Settings_InternetRadioDescription
data.value: When on, Mimi contacts Radio Browser mirrors for the station directory and a playback click count, then streams audio directly from each station. Station servers can see your IP address. Turn this off to hide Internet Radio, cancel station loading, and stop radio playback.

data.name: Settings_OnlineDescription
data.value: When on, Mimi searches the Audius catalog and streams the track you pick directly, without downloading or caching it. Audius and its content nodes can see your IP address. Nothing from the catalog is added to your local library, queue, history, favourites, or saved session. Turn this off to hide the online surface and stop an online track.

data.name: Settings_YouTubeDescription
data.value: When on, Mimi searches YouTube with your own Data API key and plays the video in YouTube's official embedded player inside Mimi. Mimi does not download, extract, or cache the media, and nothing from YouTube is added to your library, queue, history, favourites, or saved session. Turn this off to hide YouTube and stop the video.

data.name: Settings_YouTubeKeyHint

data.name: Settings_RegisterWindowsDescription
